title: Legal Document Summarization Fine-Tuning
business: Legal tech firms providing automated contract analysis for corporate law departments.
problem: Generic base models frequently hallucinate legal terminology or fail to adhere to the specific, dense formatting requirements of corporate contract summaries, leading to costly manual review cycles.
solution: Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) allows the firm to train a base model on a curated dataset of high-quality, human-verified contract summaries, forcing the model to learn the precise structure and professional tone required for legal documentation.
steps: Prepare a conversational dataset containing pairs of raw legal contracts as user inputs and expert-verified summaries as assistant outputs.
Define a chat template to ensure the model correctly distinguishes between the contract text and the required summary structure.
Configure the SFTTrainer with assistant_only_loss=True to ensure the model focuses its learning exclusively on the quality of the generated summary rather than the input contract text.
Execute the training process using a PEFT configuration to efficiently adapt the model while minimizing hardware resource consumption.
Validate the model on a held-out set of contracts to ensure adherence to the desired summary format.
outcome: The model consistently produces summaries that mirror the structure and professional precision of human-written legal documents, significantly reducing the time required for attorney oversight.
limitation: Over-fitting to the training examples can lead to a loss of general reasoning capabilities; this is checked by monitoring the validation loss and evaluating the model on diverse, unseen contract types.

diagram.description: The flow shows how raw legal data is transformed into a specialized model.

code.content:
from trl import SFTTrainer, SFTConfig
# Configure trainer to focus loss only on assistant responses
training_args = SFTConfig(assistant_only_loss=True)
trainer = SFTTrainer(
    model="Qwen/Qwen3-0.6B",
    train_dataset=legal_dataset,
    args=training_args
)
trainer.train()
code.explanation: This code initializes the SFTTrainer with a configuration that ensures the model learns specifically from the assistant's summaries, ignoring the input contract text during loss calculation.
